headline: Luca Niculescu: Government proposes to cut administrative burdens by 25% and authorisation time by 30%
summary: Prime Minister Luca Niculescu said the government proposes cutting administrative burdens for companies by 25% and authorisation times by 30%. He spoke at the AmCham Romania Forum.
why: Administrative and permitting burdens affect business costs and investment timing in Romania. Reform progress also bears on the country's OECD accession process.
